posts.title: Don’t Outsource Your Critical Judgement
posts.description: During a livestream, Cullen Kelly takes a question from the chat: Why aren’t more YouTubers, especially colorists, not [sic] making their videos in HDR? The first thing Kelly does is recommend listening to Steve Yedlin’s anti-HDR rant. Since associating with Yedlin, Kelly parrots his colleague’s talking points—even sharing what he thinks are profound insights that... Continue Reading →

posts.title: Charles Poynton: The Breaking Point of HDR
posts.description: Charles Poynton addresses Myth B: “The filmic look requires only ranges achievable in SDR.” Despite appearing on a panel literally titled “Mythbusting: Colour, Camera, Cinema,” his entire argument reinforces and validates the exact premise of the myth. posts.title: Steve Yedlin Enlightens Us All
posts.description: “Next distinguished cinematographer Steve Yedlin ASC enlightened us all on the subject of HDR.
